description: This file contains a custom React hook named useProjectCostHistorySum that fetches the summed project cost from two API endpoints, preferring the sum of cost_history.delta_total_cost. It manages state related to cost, loading, and error states, and formats the cost as USD currency. It uses React hooks such as useState, useEffect, useCallback, and useMemo, and imports external API methods getProjectCostHistorySum and getProjectCost.

methods.name: useProjectCostHistorySum(projectId, options = {})
methods.description: Hook to fetch and compute the project cost sum, handle fallback on failure, and format the result for use in UI components.
